title: World entry loader refresh
brief: Replace the current /world entry loader with clearer, calmer directions. Same rules: honest real progress capped at 99 until ready, a minimum 2.5 s reveal, errors with retry, Enter world after readiness, and a smooth entry transition with reduced-motion support.

artboards.title: Monolith meter
artboards.tradeoff: Quietest and smallest to read; shows less about what is preparing

artboards.title: Dial readout
artboards.tradeoff: Echoes the clock dial and makes the percentage the hero; a ring is more visual weight

artboards.title: Phase rail
artboards.tradeoff: Names each real milestone, so the wait is explained; more text to scan

artboards.title: Wordmark fill
artboards.tradeoff: Brand-led: KEVNNARD lights letter by letter with progress; the most identity, a little less information

artboards.title: Signal field
artboards.tradeoff: Most atmosphere: particles gather into the house as progress rises; a canvas loop, static under reduced motion

artboards.title: Blueprint home
artboards.tradeoff: Tells the story of the site: the house draws itself as a blueprint with real progress and lights up on ready; the richest to build, needs care on small screens
